en: The Apadāna of the Elder Pādaphaliya Kaṇikāra Chapter 5 I am a bhikkhu who has gone forth, having abandoned all sensual pleasures. Having seen the Buddha, the Teacher, I have attained the fruit of stream-entry. I shall go to the presence of the Blessed One; I shall see the Tathāgata. Today I shall attain the fruit of non-returning, which is difficult to obtain. I am a bhikkhu who has gone forth, having abandoned all sensual pleasures. I shall go to the presence of the Blessed One;
“The golden-hued Sambuddha,
the recipient of offerings,
was entering the street.”
I gave a foot-fruit as an offering.
In the ninety-first aeon ago,
that fruit which I then gave;
I do not know a state of woe;
this is the fruit of giving fruit.
The defilements have been burnt away by me.
I dwell free from taints.
Welcome indeed has come to me!
the Buddha’s teaching has been accomplished.
The four analytical knowledges (paṭisambhidā) have been attained.
the Buddha’s teaching has been accomplished.
Thus indeed did the Venerable Elder Pādaphaliya speak these verses.
The legend of the Elder Pādaphaliya is the fifth.
